issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The provided 97-acceptance-criteria.md file is truncated mid-sentence at AC-08, and the criteria listed are meta-checks (file existence) rather than functional logic checks for the WP plugin patterns.
issues.fix: Complete the AC file and add functional GWT cases for the 'safeExecute' pattern and Enum metadata resolution.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions Unaddressed
issues.why: While the spec covers structure and enums well, it lacks guidance on WordPress-specific concurrency (e.g., race conditions during option updates or file-system locks for the FileLogger).
issues.fix: Add a section to Phase 4 or 15 regarding the use of flock() for logging and atomic option updates.
